title: MARIO: Global mapping of protein-mediated RNA–RNA interactions in living cells
key_innovation: Compared with RNA duplex mapping methods that directly capture base-paired RNA regions, MARIO uses RNA–protein crosslinking and protein-mediated proximity ligation to identify spatially associated RNAs, enabling transcriptome-wide reconstruction of RNA interaction networks and protein-assisted RNA architectures in living cells.

blocks.text: How does MARIO capture RNA–RNA interactions through protein-mediated proximity ligation?

blocks.alt: Principle and workflow of MARIO-mediated RNA interaction mapping
blocks.legend: **Figure 1. Principle and workflow of MARIO-mediated RNA interaction mapping.** MARIO captures RNA–RNA interactions by crosslinking RNAs with endogenous RNA-binding proteins, fragmenting and biotinylating RNA–protein complexes, immobilizing RNA-binding proteins, and performing proximity ligation between spatially associated RNA fragments. The resulting chimeric RNA molecules are purified and identified by high-throughput sequencing, enabling genome-wide mapping of protein-mediated RNA interaction networks.
blocks.label: MARIO F1

blocks.text: How does MARIO reveal global RNA interaction networks?

blocks.alt: Transcriptome-wide RNA interaction networks identified by MARIO
blocks.legend: **Figure 2. Transcriptome-wide RNA interaction networks identified by MARIO.** MARIO maps extensive RNA–RNA interactions among diverse RNA classes, including mRNAs, long non-coding RNAs, microRNAs, pseudogene transcripts, and antisense RNAs. The resulting interaction network displays scale-free properties and identifies highly connected RNA interaction hubs.
blocks.label: MARIO F2

blocks.text: How can MARIO-identified RNA interactions be validated in cells?

blocks.alt: Cellular validation of MARIO-detected RNA interactions
blocks.legend: **Figure 3. Cellular validation of MARIO-detected RNA interactions.** MARIO-identified RNA interactions are validated by single-molecule RNA fluorescence in situ hybridization, demonstrating spatial co-localization between interacting RNA molecules in living cells.
blocks.label: MARIO F3

blocks.text: How does MARIO identify nucleotide-level RNA interaction sites?

blocks.alt: Identification and characterization of RNA interaction regions
blocks.legend: **Figure 4. Identification and characterization of RNA interaction regions.** MARIO interaction reads define localized RNA contact sites by clustering overlapping chimeric fragments. These interaction regions show favorable RNA–RNA binding energies and evolutionary conservation, supporting their biological relevance.
blocks.label: MARIO F4
